summary: DirectX surface blit with format-aware source/destination selection. Prepares a format buffer via sub_55C650, initializes the destination surface via sub_53F720, picks source and destination surfaces from the a2/a4 descriptor arrays using the a3/a5 flag bitmasks (1, 2, 4, 8), blits through SurfaceBlitOperation with a fill color derived from a4[6], releases temporary surfaces through their vtable+8, and optionally copies via D3DSurfaceCopyBlit when a4[11] > 1. Stops at the first failure storing -1 in *this. Returns 0 on success, and skips the whole pipeline when a6 & 0x1000000 is set. Called by sub_5429B0 (0x005429B0).

operations.description: Initialize the format buffer v19 via sub_55C650(v19, a2[12], 0).
Compute the fill color v9 from dst descriptor a4[6]: -16777216 when bit 0x800 is set, else -65281.
Prepare/allocate the destination surface via sub_53F720(this, a4, a4[11]); on a non-zero return store it in *this and return -1.
If a6 & 0x1000000 is set, skip the entire blit pipeline and return 0 immediately.
Select the source surface from the a2 descriptor using a3 flags: bit 4 -> a2[4], bit 8 -> a2[5], bit 1 -> a2[2], bit 2 -> a2[3]; if no flag matches or the chosen surface is null, return -1.
For a3 bits 4 or 8, call the selected surface's vtable method at vtable+60 with (surface, 0, &a2), storing the result in *this and returning -1 on failure.
Select the destination surface from the a4 descriptor using a5 flags with the same 1/2/4/8 bit scheme; return -1 if no flag matches or the chosen surface is null.
For a5 bits 4 or 8, call the destination surface's vtable method at vtable+60 with (surface, 0, &v18), storing the result in *this and returning -1 on failure.
Blit the selected surfaces via SurfaceBlitOperation(v18, 0, 0, a2, 0, 0, 4, v9); store the result in *this and return -1 on failure.
If a3 & 0xC, release the temporary source surface via its vtable+8 method.
If a5 & 0xC, release the temporary destination surface via its vtable+8 method.
If a4[11] > 1, copy the surface data via D3DSurfaceCopyBlit(a4[4], 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 5).
